text:
noah: Heads-up — planning to pin sable-v2 -> catalog slot 'fast-text' tonight at 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC. Plan is: canary 15m (10% traffic), then alias swap to fast-text:stable if metrics look good. Model is sable-v2-q4 (7.5B int8). Who can own deploy + smoke + rollback?

eva: I can own the deploy and smoke. I'll run the canary prompt set and a couple of perf traces. I'll post results here.

sam: I'll monitor infra metrics and dashboards. Alert thresholds for rollback: p50 latency > 250ms OR errors > 1% sustained for 3m. I'll be ready to flip.

rachel: I'll run the regression suite against the pinned prompt set (catalog/regressions/fast-text/p0). Expectation: <1% delta on our QA metric and no increase in hallucination score.

noah: Thanks. Regression suite commands: `python tests/run_regression.py --suite fast-text/p0 --model sable-v2-q4`

noah: Rollback playbook (if needed):
```
# set alias back to previous model
rbctl alias set fast-text:stable <previous-model-id>
# invalidate prefix cache
rbctl cache invalidate --alias fast-text:stable
# notify traffic team + ops
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by noah at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z -> canary start then alias swap after 15m if green.

eva: I'll limit canary to 50rps and run these smoke checks: sample prompt run (~50 queries), tokenization check, 10 long-context samples. Posting results here at ~22:20 UTC.

sam: Noted on thresholds. I'll also attach a quick dashboard link once deploy starts: https://console.redwood.example/d/fast-text/canary (monitor errors, p50/p95, qps).

rachel: Small gotcha — sable-v2 uses a slightly different tokenizer config (byte_pair_v2). I'll run tokenization unit tests and paste diffs. If token lengths change significantly, we should re-run cost estimates.

eva: All right. I'll run token tests during canary. If any of the three checks fail (regressions, tokenization mismatch, infra thresholds), we abort and run rollback steps. :thumbsup:

noah: Great — owners are set. Eva (deploy+smoke), Sam (monitor+rollback), Rachel (regressions/token tests). I'll be on call for coordination. Ping here if timeline slips.

eva: lgtm, will update thread with canary pass/fail and attach logs.

sam: I'll be on watch from 21:50 UTC onward. If I don't ack within 2m of a critical alert, escalate to @oncall.

rachel: quick note — I put a short checklist in the PR: tokenizer flag, model card updated, quantization notes. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/482

eva: thanks — rolling forward at 22:00.

noah: closing planning — will post a short post-deploy summary after the swap.
